name: Cryomass Technologies Inc.
summary: Cryomass Technologies Inc., established in 2011 and based in Denver, Colorado, specializes in the development, distribution, and commercialization of cryo-mechanical systems. These systems are specifically engineered for processing freshly harvested hemp, cannabis, and other premium botanical materials. The company rebranded to its current name in August 2021, having previously operated as Andina Gold Corp.
